table.name: TLGNC_RAILWAY_STATION_COMM
table.description: Maps operational railway stations to commercial railway stations. Ususally the operational railway station is also the commercial railway station. Otherwise, there will be a mapping of the operational railway station to its commercial railway station in this table. The commercial railway station will be used to determine prices as for some operational railway stations, no prices are available. In the SAP export order interface, both operational and commercial railway stations will be sent for rail-order.

column.name: OP_RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. Operational railway station as referenced in Shippingpoint or Ship-To and used in the timetable.

column.name: COMM_RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. Commercial railway station which is used for billing/price determination instead of the operational railway station. In Logon, only needed in SAP export order interface.
